    ADA vs SOL: what the numbers show

    Solana's market cap of about $38.64B is 7.1 times Cardano's ($5.44B); they rank #14 and #7 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Cardano fell 69.1% and Solana fell 47.9%, a gap of 21.2 percentage points in Solana's favour. Cardano was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (72.2% annualized against 57.9%). Within the year, Cardano's largest fall between daily closes was 70.3% and Solana's was 57.6%. On November 15, 2026 Cardano was 67.9% below its 52-week high and Solana 50.4% below its own. In 5 of the last 12 complete months, Cardano did better than Solana. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Cardano had a correlation of 0.84 and Solana 0.87.
